info.title: Candidate Compliance Platform API
info.description: Product-neutral REST API for tenant-scoped candidate compliance, verification, and governed CV extraction. Tenant identifiers supplied by clients are validated against the authenticated actor's memberships before domain logic runs.

post.description: Validates local credentials and returns a Bearer JWT. Authentication does not select a tenant.

get.description: Returns platform identity only; tenant selection and permissions are separate.
Returns only the authenticated actor's tenant-membership options before tenant selection. X-Tenant-Id is neither required nor used.

200.description: Authenticated actor membership options ordered by tenant name and tenant ID.

get.description: Validates X-Tenant-Id against the authenticated actor's current memberships.

post.description: Creates an active candidate owned by the validated tenant.

201.description: Candidate created, or the original response replayed for the same key and input.

get.description: Returns active candidates in deterministic order with bounded pagination and optional filters.
Returns an active candidate visible to the validated tenant.

patch.description: Updates at least one mutable candidate field within the validated tenant.

200.description: Candidate updated, or the stored response replayed.

delete.description: Performs one-way retention-safe logical removal. The candidate is excluded from normal API operations while compliance, verification, CV extraction, and audit evidence remains retained. Exact same-key replay returns 204 without another mutation.

204.description: Candidate removed logically. No response body.

post.description: Creates a logical document and its first immutable-history version as DRAFT.

get.description: Lists active logical documents and their current versions for one active candidate.
Returns active logical documents whose current version expires from the current UTC date through day 30, inclusive.
Returns an active logical document and its current version.

delete.description: Performs one-way retention-safe logical removal of the stable aggregate. Versions, supersession links, verification history, and audit evidence remain retained and unchanged. Exact same-key replay returns 204 without another mutation.

204.description: Document removed logically. No response body.

post.description: Appends a DRAFT version and makes it current. This general operation cannot overwrite or supersede an approved current version; use correction instead.

201.description: Version created and selected as current.

post.description: Transitions a DRAFT or PENDING_REVIEW current version to APPROVED. Exact same-key replay returns the stored response without duplicate audit. A new key targeting an already-approved current version succeeds as a semantic no-op, appends immutable approval evidence with equal before/after hashes and ALREADY_APPROVED metadata, and does not mutate document state.

200.description: Current version approved or already approved.

post.description: Creates a new DRAFT that supersedes the approved current version and becomes current. The approved version is retained unchanged as immutable history.

201.description: Corrected DRAFT version created and selected as current.

post.description: Atomically creates a requested verification, outbox event, audit evidence, and idempotency result for an approved current RIGHT_TO_WORK version.

202.description: Verification request accepted for asynchronous processing.

get.description: Returns a tenant-visible verification request and records a sensitive-read audit event.

post.description: Accepts one raw PDF or UTF-8 text CV up to 2 MiB. Extracted text is limited to 100,000 characters and processed in memory. Raw bytes and text are not persisted. Provider output is untrusted and must pass strict validation before a PROPOSED, non-authoritative result is stored. Extraction never rejects or otherwise decides the candidate.

schema.description: Non-empty UTF-8 text; raw request size is additionally capped at 2 MiB.
PDF bytes with a valid PDF signature, capped at 2 MiB, yielding non-empty extracted text.

201.description: Validated advisory proposal created with status PROPOSED.

get.description: Returns tenant-visible proposal and decision evidence without exposing raw CV content.

post.summary: Confirm or edit a CV extraction
post.description: Validates the authorised recruiter's complete profile independently, retains the original proposal, stores confirmed evidence separately, and changes the proposal from PROPOSED to ACCEPTED.

200.description: Proposal accepted with separately retained confirmed output.

post.description: Changes only the advisory proposal from PROPOSED to REJECTED. It never rejects, disables, scores, or ranks the candidate and does not create a confirmed profile.

200.description: Proposal rejected without changing candidate state.

TenantIdHeader.name: X-Tenant-Id
TenantIdHeader.description: Untrusted tenant selection validated against the authenticated actor's current memberships.

IdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Opaque key scoped by validated tenant membership and operation. Same input replays the stored response; conflicting reuse returns 409.

CandidateSearch.name: search
CandidateSearch.description: Case-insensitive partial match across supported candidate search fields.

BadRequest.description: Request validation, tenant selection, upload, or idempotency key failed.

Unauthorized.description: Credentials or Bearer authentication are invalid.

Forbidden.description: Tenant context is unavailable or the operation-specific permission is denied.

NotFound.description: The resource is missing, inactive, or unavailable in the selected tenant.

Conflict.description: A domain invariant or idempotency-key reuse conflicts with this request.

BadGateway.description: The CV provider failed or returned invalid untrusted output.

accessToken.description: Bearer JWT; example is intentionally not a usable token.

ComplianceDocumentCreateRequest.description: When both dates are non-null, expiryDate must not be earlier than issueDate.

ComplianceDocumentVersionCreateRequest.description: Both fields are optional. When both are non-null, expiryDate must not be earlier than issueDate.

ComplianceDocumentCorrectionRequest.description: Complete corrected date state. When both dates are non-null, expiryDate must not be earlier than issueDate.

skills.description: Trimmed and case-insensitively deduplicated by the runtime.

certifications.description: Trimmed and case-insensitively deduplicated by the runtime.

confirmedOutput.description: Null until an authorised human confirms independently validated data.
